query: How to operationalize active learning under limited labeling (acquisition function, batch sizes, stopping criteria tied to marginal validation gains)?

response.query: How to operationalize active learning under limited labeling (acquisition function, batch sizes, stopping criteria tied to marginal validation gains)?
response.answer: To operationalize active learning under limited labeling, use an acquisition function like uncertainty sampling, select batch sizes based on marginal validation gains, and stop when gains plateau.

results.title: Review and Renewal of Eligibility for Application-Specific Allowances
results.content: This rulemaking proposes the framework for how EPA will assess whether to renew the eligibility of applications to receive application-specific allowances.

results.content: Docket Title | Document ID | Comments || Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act (CIRCIA) Reporting Requirements | [CISA-2022-0010-0163](https://www.regulations.gov/document/CISA-2022-0010-0163) | [300](https://www.regulations.gov/document/CISA-2022-0010-0163/comment) |  |. Among other benefits, this new authority will enhance CISA's ability to identify trends and track cyber threat activity across the cyber threat landscape beyond the Federal agencies that are already required to report information on certain cyber incidents to CISA pursuant to the FISMA, [44 U.S.C. 3554(b)(7)(C)(ii)](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/44/3554) and [6 U.S.C. 652(c)(3)](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/6/652).
